faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Pricing
faq.desc: Things you need to know before initializing services at ecor.vn
faq.q1: Can I change my service plan as my company grows?
faq.a1: Absolutely. The eCor system supports upgrading or adding warehouses, trucks, or user accounts at any time. The difference will be automatically calculated and prorated based on the remaining actual usage days in the billing cycle.
faq.q2: How are Onsite deployment and staff training costs calculated?
faq.a2: For the annual Professional and Small Chain plans, eCor offers a free standard onboarding package worth 15,000,000 VND, including online training and system setup guidance. In cases requiring on-site surveys and deployment for several days, costs will be transparently agreed upon based on the location.
faq.q3: Is ecor compatible with existing Barcode scanners / PDAs?
faq.a3: Yes. ecor WMS and POS applications support all Android-running devices (Zebra, Honeywell, Datalogic, Sunmi, Urovo...) as well as wireless Bluetooth or wired USB barcode scanners connected directly to a computer.
faq.q4: How is our logistics and customer data secured?
faq.a4: Your small business data is encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit, hosted on ISO/IEC 27001-certified cloud infrastructure with daily automated backups and a commitment never to share it with third parties.

faq.q1: How long does it take ecor.vn to deploy into our existing warehouse?

faq.a3: Yes. ecor provides an Open API gateway and RESTful Webhook system allowing 2-way auto-sync with SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, MISA AMIS, Fast, Bravo, and internal systems.
